title: Mixed Event — The Moon Rabbit & Us — Episode3 Theme: Fall

meta.Event Outline: With MORE MORE JUMP!'s next stream approaching, Shizuku starts thinking of autumn-themed ideas, triggering childhood memories of when she went moon viewing with Shiho. She invites her sister to go together once again...

rows.Line: The next day
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hello, Minori!
Oh, all of you are here♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we'd like to talk to you about what we'll be doing for our next stream. Would any of you be available for a quick discussion?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Of course♪
I can't wait to hear what you'll be doing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks!
And thanks for always helping us out like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then why don't we get right down to it♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, about our next segment...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... I actually have some ideas that I'd like to discuss with you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You do? That's great, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, lay it on us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
If you'll allow me to explain...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. A fall-based segment...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We'd be able to introduce books, sports and even foods that we like or recommend. Wouldn't that be wonderful?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! That sounds great!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I agree. That sounds really amazing!
Fall's the season for roasted sweet potatoes, Mont Blanc cakes and pumpkin pie...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're just saying that because you want to eat them, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Whether they're being eaten or you yourselves are eating them, delicious foods do seem like a good choice!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We won't be able to have too much...
But it could be interesting if each of us recommended something and did a little taste test.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you'd even learn a little about what someone's like based on what they choose♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That would be interesting. It may also be fun to make some yourself♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is it time for Minori's salt-instead-of-sugar flan or Shizuku's flan that's really some other kind of egg dish to finally make an appearance?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're so mean, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's no way I'd do that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haha. Relax, I'm kidding!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm so jealous!
I wanna do that with you guys too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too♪ Although, just talking about it is already pretty exciting.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I agree♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Dessert making sounds lovely and it may be fun to see all of you breaking a sweat while playing some sports too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Breaking a sweat...? Oh!
Like a squeaky-clean cleaning contest!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We can compete to see who can get their room to be the cleanest! We'd be breaking a sweat, but it's also an opportunity to really clean our rooms♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's not a bad idea...
But I feel like that might get old fast.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi may be right. However, it may be something to consider after we eat a little too much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What if you made it a sort of time trial? Wouldn't that make it more interesting?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, yes it would♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You'll have to get through me to win!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. This is turning into quite the segment.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, but...
I'd sort of prefer it if we did something more directly related to fall.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More directly related...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, they're all individually great ideas, but not really all that fall-related or different from what we usually do, you know?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I still think they'd be really fun...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At the same time, I see Airi's point.

rows.Speaker: Everybody
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Since it's fall, why not do a moon viewing♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You could even invite your fans to join you on the night of the 15th, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A moon viewing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I never would've thought of that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I like it since it fits right in with our seasonal theme!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (A moon viewing...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, how did you make that rabbit?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree...
I especially like the part about our fans being able to join in on the festivities.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Together with your fans...
That means you'll all be looking up towards the same moon.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That sounds so romantic!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But what do we do during that time?
We can't just all blankly stare at the moon while we're live.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, for instance...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We could make, put some dango on display and eat the rest, or make some rabbit masks and pretend to be rabbits while we stream.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, rabbit masks!
I wanna try making some too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've never made dango before, so I'd really like to give that a try! I bet it'll be really fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure it will be. I also believe that it'll be a wonderful way for us to express ourselves as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only that, it'll feel like a special occasion. I say why not?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I'm up for it too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, we'll need to work out what exactly we'll be doing, such as what activities we'll be doing and what we'll need to prepare in advance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...!
In that case, would you mind if I handled all of that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you sure, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! I think I have a wonderful idea for this, so please let me do this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're that set on this, huh? We're gonna be expecting something really good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course. You can count on me!
